title: About | Data Learning Hub
description: About Data Learning Hub, its Next.js PWA architecture, published tutorials, privacy model, and credits.
mainHtml:
About the platform

A Next.js PWA, tutorial-first and transparent Data Analytics learning platform

Data Learning Hub teaches Data Analytics first, then extends the same architecture into Data Science and Data Engineering.

What v2.7.0 provides

A Next.js App Router PWA with six complete tutorials: Data Foundations, Excel, SQL, Power BI, Python, and a 49-chapter Analytics Workflows course; together with 1,089 chapter exercises, six complete portfolio projects, final quizzes, reference libraries, downloadable practice assets, 108 retained lessons, and 20 statistical labs. The application is installable, includes an offline fallback, and preserves all published routes and browser-local progress.

Publication honesty

Only complete tutorials are labeled published. Curriculum-ready modules show scope and target release, but never pretend to be complete tutorial pages.

Privacy

No backend, API, database or account is required. Language, theme, progress, bookmarks and plan preferences remain optional browser-local data.

Progress migration

On first load, v2 copies compatible v1 browser preferences from the old slh-* keys into versioned dlh-* keys. The original keys are not deleted.
